integrity: The analytic proof and reproducible numerical consistency checker are supplied. Self-review is not independent certification; no external validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Endpoint symmetrized Gaussian Kullback–Leibler reward per unit time for one-dimensional OU cycles with fresh independent centered Gaussian cold resets. Not hardware-inclusive entropy production, general non-Gaussian resetting, or arbitrary time-correlated protocols. The square-root scaling is a large hot/cold temperature-ratio limit.
title: A unique finite-width reset-cycle KL peak and its square-root protocol gap
